definitions.gloss: minting; coinage; the manufacture of coins and medals
definitions.explanation: The process of producing coins, medals, and similar metal items. Most commonly encountered in the compound {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく} (the Mint).

examples.japanese: {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}を{見学|けんがく}した。
examples.english: I visited the Mint on a tour.

examples.japanese: {造幣|ぞうへい}{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{偽造|ぎぞう}{防止|ぼうし}のために{進化|しんか}してきた。
examples.english: Minting technology has evolved to prevent counterfeiting.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}の{造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}は{桜|さくら}の{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}けでも{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: The Osaka Mint is also famous for its cherry blossom walkway.

notes:
Composed of {造|ぞう} (to make, to create) + {幣|へい} (currency, coin). Most often encountered in the compound {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}, Japan's Mint, which has facilities in Osaka, Tokyo, and Hiroshima.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく}: the Mint (Japan Mint)
- {造幣|ぞうへい}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: minting technology
- {造幣|ぞうへい}{事業|じぎょう}: minting operations

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {造幣局|ぞうへいきょく} in Osaka is famous for its annual {桜|さくら}の{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}け (cherry blossom passage), a one-week event each April when the public can walk through the grounds to view over 100 varieties of cherry trees. It is one of Osaka's most popular spring events.
